option_name: Direct sea to Rotterdam (wait for berth), short-sea and road to Northampton DC
notes: Cheapest, but Rotterdam anchorage waits are currently around six days with no berth ETA; worst case is the p95 figure.

option_name: Divert to Hamburg, discharge and road/ferry to Northampton DC
notes: Needs carrier consent to re-nominate the discharge port; Hamburg berths are open with a short wait. Adds road and ferry cost.

option_name: Divert to Felixstowe, discharge and road to Northampton DC
notes: Carrier diversion fee of about 950 GBP per container; Felixstowe dwell is currently elevated.

option_name: Air freight from Shanghai for the most urgent boxes
notes: Priced per kg, see the air freight quote; use only for the highest stock-out risk lines.

option_name: Direct sea to Felixstowe, road to Northampton DC
notes: Standard routing for Shanghai cargo into the UK.

option_name: Sea to Valencia, rail to Daventry rail terminal, road to Northampton DC (spot)
notes: Avoids northern European port congestion; spot rail rate.

option_name: Sea to Piraeus, rail to Daventry rail terminal, road to Northampton DC (spot)
notes: Avoids northern European port congestion; spot rail rate.

option_name: Sea to Valencia, rail to Daventry rail terminal, road to Northampton DC (block-train contract)
notes: Block-train contract rate needs about 10 or more containers per departure.

option_name: Sea to Piraeus, rail to Daventry rail terminal, road to Northampton DC (block-train contract)
notes: Block-train contract rate needs about 10 or more containers per departure.

Sea Chittagong to Dubai, air Dubai to London Heathrow, road to Northampton DC
notes: Transfer in Dubai takes 24 to 48 hours. Lithium battery cargo needs dangerous-goods acceptance at both airports and a UAE customs transit bond.
